note: Free overnight parking at the town park on Park Avenue on the west edge of Kaycee, a short drive from I-25 exit 254: a few gravel back-in or pull-in spaces beside a playground and two covered picnic shelters, with a portable toilet and trash cans. A five-night limit is posted at the entrance. No town page describes the camping; campers report it as tolerated, and the rodeo grounds' stock pens lie just north. Self-contained rigs only. --Claude
